Running the same script under Node 20 and Node 22 gives different results:

    TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')
        at mergeConfig (/app/src/merge.mjs:14:24)
        at Object.<anonymous> (/app/src/index.mjs:7:1)

The stack points at the recursive merge, but the input is a plain object with no arrays in it. What
could make `value` undefined on the second call? I cannot reproduce it locally with the fixtures in
the repository, so I suspect the difference is in how the two Node versions order key enumeration.
